title: Exercise Dosage — FITT, RPE & Reps in Reserve

hook.en: Stop prescribing "3 sets of 10 for everyone". Learn to dose exercise like medicine.
hook.ur: "Sab ke liye 3 sets of 10" band karein. Exercise ko dawai ki tarah dose karna seekhein.

goal.en: By the end, you'll write an exercise prescription that is specific, measurable and easy to progress — instead of guessing.
goal.ur: End tak aap aisi exercise prescription likh sakenge jo specific, measurable aur asaani se progress hone wali ho — andaze ke bajaye.

text.en: "Do 3 sets of 10" is the most common prescription in physiotherapy — and often the least thought-through. A good dose answers four questions: **how often, how hard, how long, and what type**. That's **FITT**.
text.ur: "3 sets of 10 karein" physiotherapy ki sab se aam prescription hai — aur aksar sab se kam soch samajh wali. Achi dose chaar sawalon ka jawab deti hai: **kitni baar, kitna mushkil, kitni dair, aur kis qism ki**. Yehi **FITT** hai.

text.en:
**F**requency — how often per week.
**I**ntensity — how hard.
**T**ime — how long, or how many sets and reps.
**T**ype — aerobic, strength, balance or flexibility.
Modern guidelines add **V**olume and **P**rogression → **FITT-VP**.
text.ur:
**F**requency — hafte mein kitni baar.
**I**ntensity — kitna mushkil.
**T**ime — kitni dair, ya kitne sets aur reps.
**T**ype — aerobic, strength, balance ya flexibility.
Jadeed guidelines **V**olume aur **P**rogression bhi add karti hain → **FITT-VP**.

simpler.en: How often, how hard, how long, what kind — and how you'll make it harder over time.
simpler.ur: Kitni baar, kitna mushkil, kitni dair, kis qism ki — aur waqt ke saath ise mushkil kaise karenge.

text.en: Exercise is medicine. Too little does nothing, too much causes side effects, and the right dose depends on the person. You'd never write "some tablets, sometimes" on a prescription — so never write "some exercises, sometimes".
text.ur: Exercise dawai hai. Bohat kam ka koi asar nahi, bohat zyada ke side effects, aur sahi dose insaan ke mutabiq hoti hai. Aap kabhi prescription par "kuch goliyan, kabhi kabhi" nahi likhenge — to "kuch exercises, kabhi kabhi" bhi kabhi na likhein.

text.en:
Intensity is the hardest part to get right. Three practical tools:
**RPE** — rating of perceived exertion: how hard it feels (Borg 6–20 scale).
**Talk test** — for aerobic work: can they talk? sing?
**Reps in reserve (RIR)** — for strength: how many more good reps could they have done at the end of the set?
text.ur:
Intensity sahi karna sab se mushkil hai. Teen practical tools:
**RPE** — rating of perceived exertion: kitna mushkil mehsoos hota hai (Borg 6–20 scale).
**Talk test** — aerobic kaam ke liye: kya baat kar sakte hain? gaa sakte hain?
**Reps in reserve (RIR)** — strength ke liye: set ke end par kitne aur ache reps kar sakte thay?

intro.en: Slide through the Borg 6–20 scale and see what each level feels like — and what the talk test tells you.
intro.ur: Borg 6–20 scale par slide karein aur dekhein har level kaisa mehsoos hota hai — aur talk test kya batata hai.

question.en: Your patient finishes a set of squats and says they could have done about 2 more reps with good form. What's their RIR?
question.ur: Patient squats ka set khatam kar ke kehta hai ke achi form ke saath taqreeban 2 aur reps kar sakta tha. RIR kya hai?

feedback.en: RIR 0 means they couldn't have done a single extra rep — true failure.
feedback.ur: RIR 0 ka matlab ek bhi extra rep mumkin nahi tha — mukammal failure.

feedback.en: Yes — 2 reps in reserve. For most strength goals, ending sets at about 1–3 RIR is a good, safe target.
feedback.ur: Haan — 2 reps in reserve. Zyada tar strength goals ke liye sets ko taqreeban 1–3 RIR par khatam karna acha aur safe target hai.

feedback.en: That would be the reps they did, not the reps they had left.
feedback.ur: Yeh jo reps kiye woh hote, bache hue reps nahi.

title.en: Typical starting doses (then adjust to the person)
title.ur: Aam shuruati doses (phir insaan ke mutabiq adjust karein)

rows.en: Last reps are hard; about 1–3 reps in reserve
rows.ur: Aakhri reps mushkil; taqreeban 1–3 reps in reserve
Hafte mein 2–3 din · halke wazan (~40–60% 1RM) se 15+ reps
Muscle mein jalan, form theek rahe
Hafte mein 150–300 min darmiyani, ya 75–150 min shadeed
Darmiyani: baat kar sakte hain, gaa nahi sakte (RPE ~12–13)

rows.en: 3+ days/week as part of multicomponent activity
rows.ur: Hafte mein 3+ din, multicomponent activity ka hissa

rows.en: Challenging but safe — supervise if fall risk is high
rows.ur: Mushkil magar safe — fall risk zyada ho to supervision

question.en: Your COPD patient is walking on a treadmill for aerobic training. Which response tells you they're at a MODERATE intensity?
question.ur: Aap ka COPD patient aerobic training ke liye treadmill par chal raha hai. Kaun sa response batata hai ke woh DARMIYANI intensity par hai?

text.en: "I could sing along to the radio."
text.ur: "Main radio ke saath gaa sakta hoon."

feedback.en: That's light intensity — fine for a warm-up, but usually too easy to build fitness.
feedback.ur: Yeh halki intensity hai — warm-up ke liye theek, lekin fitness banane ke liye aam tor par bohat asaan.

text.en: "I can talk in sentences, but I couldn't sing."
text.ur: "Main jumlon mein baat kar sakta hoon, lekin gaa nahi sakta."

feedback.en: Exactly — the talk test's moderate zone, about RPE 12–13. (In lung disease, also watch breathlessness and SpO₂ as your service protocol directs.)
feedback.ur: Bilkul — talk test ka darmiyani zone, taqreeban RPE 12–13. (Lung disease mein service protocol ke mutabiq saans phoolna aur SpO₂ bhi dekhein.)

text.en: "I can only manage a word or two."
text.ur: "Main sirf ek do lafz bol pa raha hoon."

feedback.en: That's vigorous to very hard — too high for most patients early in rehab.
feedback.ur: Yeh shadeed se bohat mushkil hai — early rehab mein zyada tar patients ke liye bohat zyada.

text.en: Progression rules: change **one variable at a time** (load, reps, sets, frequency or difficulty). Progress when the target reps feel easy with good form; hold or regress if pain flares. In tendon rehab, a common pain-monitoring rule: pain during exercise up to about 5/10 is acceptable if it settles by the next morning and doesn't build week to week.
text.ur: Progression ke usool: **ek waqt mein ek cheez** badlein (load, reps, sets, frequency ya mushkil). Jab target reps achi form ke saath asaan lagein to progress karein; dard bharke to rokein ya kam karein. Tendon rehab mein aam pain-monitoring rule: exercise ke dauraan taqreeban 5/10 tak dard qabil-e-qubool hai agar agli subah tak theek ho jaye aur hafta ba hafta na barhe.

question.en: A knee OA patient does 3 × 10 sit-to-stands easily, no pain, RPE 9/20. Best next step?
question.ur: Knee OA ka patient 3 × 10 sit-to-stands asaani se karta hai, dard nahi, RPE 9/20. Behtareen agla qadam?

text.en: Keep the same dose for three more months
text.ur: Agle teen mahine wohi dose rakhein

feedback.en: RPE 9 is "very light" — too easy to drive adaptation. Time to progress.
feedback.ur: RPE 9 "bohat halka" hai — adaptation ke liye bohat asaan. Progress ka waqt hai.

text.en: Progress one variable — e.g. a lower chair or holding a weight
text.ur: Ek variable progress karein — maslan neechi kursi ya haath mein wazan

feedback.en: Exactly — one change, then see how the knee responds over the next 24 hours.
feedback.ur: Bilkul — ek tabdeeli, phir agle 24 ghante mein knee ka response dekhein.

text.en: Increase sets, reps and load all at once
text.ur: Sets, reps aur load sab ek saath barhayein

feedback.en: Too many changes at once — if it flares, you won't know which change caused it.
feedback.ur: Ek saath bohat tabdeeliyan — agar bharka to pata nahi chalega kis tabdeeli se.

prompt.en: Sort by type — then remember: aerobic → talk test/RPE; strength → RIR/%1RM.
prompt.ur: Type ke hisaab se sort karein — phir yaad rakhein: aerobic → talk test/RPE; strength → RIR/%1RM.

why.ur: Musalsal, rhythm wala, bare muscles — aerobic.

why.en: Moves a load for sets of reps — strength.
why.ur: Sets aur reps mein wazan — strength.
Musalsal poore jism ka kaam — aerobic.

why.en: Resistance for sets of reps — strength.
why.ur: Sets aur reps mein resistance — strength.

text.en: Common mistakes: the same dose for every patient; intensity too low to cause any adaptation (many rehab strength programmes are under-dosed); progressing everything at once; and never writing the dose down — so nobody can repeat it or progress it.
text.ur: Aam ghaltiyan: har patient ke liye wohi dose; intensity itni kam ke koi adaptation na ho (bohat se rehab strength programmes under-dosed hote hain); sab kuch ek saath barhana; aur dose kabhi likhna nahi — taake koi dohra sake na progress kar sake.

question.en: Write a complete starting prescription for a 60-year-old with knee OA beginning strength work.
question.ur: Knee OA wale 60 saal ke patient ke liye jo strength shuru kar raha hai, mukammal shuruati prescription likhein.

answer.en: Example: sit-to-stand from a standard chair · 2–3 days/week · 2 sets of 10–12 reps · last 2–3 reps feel hard (about 2 RIR, RPE ~13–15) · 1–2 min rest between sets. Progress by lowering the chair or holding a weight once all reps feel easy; reduce if knee pain is worse the next morning.
answer.ur: Misaal: aam kursi se sit-to-stand · hafte mein 2–3 din · 2 sets, 10–12 reps · aakhri 2–3 reps mushkil (taqreeban 2 RIR, RPE ~13–15) · sets ke beech 1–2 min aaram. Jab saare reps asaan lagein to kursi neechi karein ya wazan pakrayein; agli subah knee ka dard barha ho to kam karein.

text.en: **FITT-VP**: Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type — plus Volume and Progression. If it isn't written down, it isn't a prescription.
text.ur: **FITT-VP**: Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type — saath Volume aur Progression. Jo likha na ho, woh prescription nahi.

summary.en: Prescribe with FITT-VP: frequency, intensity, time, type, volume, progression.
summary.ur: FITT-VP ke saath prescribe karein: frequency, intensity, time, type, volume, progression.

summary.en: Measure intensity: RPE and the talk test for aerobic work; reps in reserve or %1RM for strength.
summary.ur: Intensity naapein: aerobic ke liye RPE aur talk test; strength ke liye reps in reserve ya %1RM.

summary.en: Progress one variable at a time and use next-day symptoms to guide the dose.
summary.ur: Ek waqt mein ek variable progress karein aur agle din ke symptoms se dose guide karein.

back.en: Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type, Volume, Progression.
back.ur: Frequency, Intensity, Time, Type, Volume, Progression.

front.en: Moderate aerobic intensity on the Borg 6–20 scale and talk test?
front.ur: Borg 6–20 aur talk test par darmiyani aerobic intensity?

back.en: About RPE 12–13: can talk in sentences but can't sing.
back.ur: Taqreeban RPE 12–13: jumlon mein baat kar sakte hain, gaa nahi sakte.

back.en: How many more good-form reps could have been done at the end of the set.
back.ur: Set ke end par achi form ke saath kitne aur reps ho sakte thay.

front.ur: Naye insaan ki aam strength dose?

back.en: 2–3 days/week, 1–3 sets of 8–12 reps at ~60–70% 1RM, ending ~1–3 RIR.
back.ur: Hafte mein 2–3 din, 1–3 sets, 8–12 reps, ~60–70% 1RM, end par ~1–3 RIR.

front.ur: WHO 2020 adults ke liye aerobic activity?

back.en: 150–300 min/week moderate or 75–150 min vigorous (or a combination), plus strengthening 2+ days/week.
back.ur: Hafte mein 150–300 min darmiyani ya 75–150 min shadeed (ya dono mila kar), saath 2+ din strengthening.

note.ur: Har progression ke peeche ka usool.

note.en: Apply FITT to a real condition.
note.ur: FITT ko asli condition par apply karein.

note.en: Dosing aerobic work with RPE and breathlessness.
note.ur: RPE aur saans phoolne ke saath aerobic dose.
